rollups.text: Travel interests and plans: Japan trip enjoyed in June (year unspecified; reported 2023-03-01); family trip to Maui in April (year unspecified; photos still unsorted on 2023-03-01); romantic anniversary getaway to Napa Valley, California, considered on 2023-02-11, with a possible hot-air-balloon ride, The Inn at St. Helena, Bistro Don Giovanni, Opus One and Silver Oak Cellars (intentions, not confirmed bookings); Chicago trip planned for around March 2023, with a later Chicago visit also being planned on 2023-03-15 (previous visit included time with Rachel and her family after a funeral); solo Asia trip considered on 2023-03-01, with Taiwan first and Taroko National Park and Sun Moon Lake of interest, and Vietnam also under consideration; Mount Takao hike considered on 2023-03-05; family trip to Hawaii in February 2023 enjoyed, with a possible return to Kailua-Kona and a day trip to Hilo considered on 2023-03-15 (not booked).

Cooking interests, classes and dishes: took a Thai cooking class on 2023-03-10 and learned green curry from scratch and jasmine rice; has experimented with chicken and shrimp in green curry and worked on perfecting jasmine rice; has been trying homemade ramen and is interested in sushi and Japanese-inspired cooking; wants restaurant-style teriyaki sauce and asked about making chicken teriyaki; planned grilled chicken donburi with shiitake mushrooms, pickled ginger and jasmine rice, and wants to make homemade furikake; after trying Italian food at a downtown restaurant, planned to start beginner Italian cooking with Spaghetti Aglio e Olio; interested in traditional Mayan dishes including laulau and kalua pig for a possible Hawaii visit.

Dance and movement: began Saturday dance classes on 2023-01-10 and continued weekly through at least 2023-03-12, practicing at home between classes; took a salsa class near work on 2023-03-04, enjoyed it and praised instructor Alex; by 2023-03-08 planned to continue beginner salsa classes and practice footwork and arm movements at home; interested in salsa, hip hop, contemporary dance and breaking, and prefers group classes, with weeknights after 6 p.m. or weekends and a hoped-for price below $20 per class; by 2023-03-12 said dancing had helped them get in shape and they had lost 5 pounds; considered a possible studio showcase performance for 2023-04-17, with upbeat hip hop and possible breaking moves, but had not decided to perform.

Car and auto racing: replaced car spark plugs with new NGK plugs on 2023-02-14 after a slight commute misfire and reported a major improvement; prepared for auto-racing events and planned to inspect or replace suspension bushings; considered brake-pad and high-performance brake-fluid upgrades, and had new discounted brake pads not installed as of 2023-03-15; completed 10 laps at Speed Demon Racing Track during Turbocharged Tuesdays on 2023-03-15, averaging 85 mph, and wanted better lap times and handling; a previous dyno test at Performance Garage's Tune-Up Saturday showed 240 horsepower, lower than expected, and the user was considering another dyno test and a tune.

Music learning and equipment: took online beginner guitar lessons through Guitar Tricks from around mid-January 2023 and was on lesson 12 by 2023-02-19; wanted more guidance with acoustic-guitar fingerpicking; had a recently repaired acoustic guitar and considered recording songs at a local studio to share professionally recorded demos with friends and family; acquired a ukulele from a sister and was learning from YouTube, then sought structured beginner lessons; considered a digital piano and planned to try both the Yamaha P-125 and Kawai ES110 in person before choosing.

Summer Fest handmade-goods sales project: on 2023-03-04, sold more than 20 items at the Downtown Farmers' Market for $150; by June 2023 was preparing a budget and spreadsheet for an upcoming Summer Fest, planning to sell handmade soaps and candles and track inventory and expenses for raw materials, packaging and related supplies; planned to share a stall with friend Emily, who sells handmade jewelry, and cross-promote products. On 2023-03-10, they planned social-media content, behind-the-scenes posts, sneak peeks, offers, shared hashtags and account tags, weekly strategy calls, and sharing the user's Instagram analytics with Emily. The elapsed time from the market sale to the planned June event was about three months; Summer Fest participation was a plan, not a reported completed event.

Commute trial: on 2023-03-13, the user described taking a 7:15 a.m. train downtown on weekdays for the prior three months, with a roughly 1-hour-15-minute door-to-door commute, usually driving to the station and parking, and spending about $250 on train tickets and gas over the preceding month. They were interested in saving time and money and trying a bike-and-train commute. From 2023-03-13 to 2023-03-20, they planned a one-week trial, including planning the route and returning the shared bike on time, then intended to assess the outcome; no trial result is recorded.

Marketing-career development: on 2023-02-25, the user described being a Marketing Specialist with about 3 years and 9 months of experience and considered transitioning to a Marketing Manager role in tech. They had taken three courses in the preceding two months to develop data-analysis and digital-marketing skills and planned two more by the end of 2023. They were interested in advanced learning resources and chose to pursue Google Analytics certification first; HubSpot Inbound Marketing certification remained a possibility rather than a commitment. The assistant assessed that a manager role could be attainable depending on leadership experience and identified strategic planning, budgeting, team development and stakeholder management as potential gaps.

Chicago travel and dining planning: on 2023-02-14, the user planned a Chicago trip for a few weeks later and intended to fly United into O'Hare; before the flight, they favored a manageable breakfast sandwich and coffee at The Berghoff over a full hot dog. On 2023-03-15, they described another upcoming Chicago visit and recalled an earlier trip for a funeral, when they spent a few days with Rachel and her family and had little chance to explore. They sought casual, affordable burgers and sandwiches, deep-dish pizza, and West Loop Italian food and pasta. No dates, bookings or completed dining choices were reported.
The user reported selling more than 20 items at the Downtown Farmers' Market on 2023-03-04 and earning $150 total; this is one reported market-sale event in the records.
The user reported having lost 5 pounds by 2023-03-12, attributing the change to dancing over the preceding few weeks; this is one reported weight-change figure.

The user's smartwatch preference shifted from relying on a generic-brand watch bought for $179.99 during a Prime Day sale to exploring alternatives with advanced health monitoring, especially ECG and stress tracking. Battery-life issues with the current watch were part of the comparison; on 2023-03-15, the user showed particular interest in Fitbit Sense and its EDA Scan, including stress tracking during commuting and accuracy while running or cycling.

The user said they usually felt more energized on Mondays and Tuesdays and had lower energy on Wednesdays, attributing the midweek dip to numerous Wednesday meetings. After a particularly draining meeting on 2023-02-22, they planned to take breaks during Wednesday meetings and prioritize evening self-care; this records a recurring weekly energy pattern and a planned coping change, not a count of separate fatigue episodes.
